The table lists every atom of one conventional cell (cell parameters in the first line of the table) of C14 H10 (C14 H10, COD 5000181). Use the kinematic structure factor with atomic numbers as angle-independent weights (C = 6, H = 1). For radiation of wavelength 1.54056 Å and first-order Bragg diffraction, at what angle 2θ does the lowest-angle reflection with non-zero intensity appear?

选项：
A. 4.73°
B. 9.45°
C. 10.47°
D. 22.04°
